name: The Chasm
description:
When played: Generate 5 random Event Cards in our deck.
When your Adventure Count reaches an even number of times: Create a random basic Elemental Die and draw 1 card.
When your Adventure Count reaches 10, and you play 2 cards whose names were not in the initial deck at the start of the match in this Round: Create 3 Omni Dice, then discard this card.
